remarks: Charming ranch-style home in North Stamford featuring 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, ideally situated on a quiet cul-de-sac. This sun-filled home offers a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, a dining area conveniently located just off the kitchen, and a versatile playroom or office with direct access to a private backyard. Enjoy an abundance of closet space throughout, along with a full basement providing exceptional storage. Complete with a two-car garage, this home combines comfort, functionality, and a peaceful setting. Roof is only 5 years old. 2025 Draining pipes were replaced with PVC, new water heater tank AND pressure tank. In addition, generator connection is already in place. City of Stamford is in the process of installing public sewer in the street to be completed in the following months. Conveniently located just 45 MINUTES from NYC, with easy access to the Merritt Parkway in under 5 minutes.
